Encounter.Name: Contact Orion Syndicate
Encounter.DescriptionText: You hail the Syndicate vessel. After a few moments a crackling voice answers over the subspace channel:

Message.Text: Hello again, SING. Have you come to pay what you owe like a good customer? It will cost you MONEY credits this time. The Syndicate does not forget debts.

Response.Text: Change your mind and tell them to leave you alone.

Message.Text: Thank you, SING. These credits are very shiny. You are once again under the Syndicate's protection.
Then why waste our time? Your freighters will pay for this.
You cannot afford it? Then your freighters will have to cover the difference.
